THE RESIDENCE

Jewel Crest View

Third in the series of projects launched at Kakkanad after the success of ‘Jewel Lexington’ and ‘Jewel Keningston’. Crest View captures the calm ambience suited for a relaxed life after the hectic hours of a busy day. The amenities include centralised gas supply, children’s play area, two lifts service and passenger, spacious recreation area and children’s play area, fitness bay, swimming pool, uninterrupted power and 24 hr water supply.
